shields_note: Posted under 'DeFENSIVE SHIELDS' outside the 60: Don't Do That Again, Only Jedi Carry That Weapon, Your Insight Serves You Well, A Tragedy Has Occurred, 'podrace shield', Ounee Ta and '4 others to fit meta' (not named).
notes: Posted 8 December 2001, before Theed Palace, so the format is Premiere - Reflections III; no Theed Palace cards are listed.

Starting cards as posted under START(6): Dagobah, Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can (posted 'MYYHL'; the title reads MWYHL), Heading For The Medical Frigate, Insurrection & Aim High, Battle Plan, An Unusual Amount Of Fear; these count toward the 60.

Battle Plan in the starting section is dested as the Endor Effect started with Heading For The Medical Frigate; Draw Their Fire is listed separately under Effects (strategy: 'The only other effect I could start would be draw their fire').
Posted 'podrace shield' dested A Close Race, the only Light Defensive Shield about Podraces.

Posted 'Tat Mos Espa DB' dested Tatooine: Mos Espa Docking Bay (strategy: '3 DB'); 'Obi-Wan w/ saber' (listed under Characters) dested Obi-Wan With Lightsaber; 'Leia w/ gun' dested Leia With Blaster Rifle (strategy: 'leia w/ blaster'); 'Chewie with gun' dested Chewie With Blaster Rifle.

Posted 'Qui-Gon (Tat)' dested Qui-Gon Jinn (Tatooine); 'Qui-Gon (R3)' dested Qui-Gon Jinn, Jedi Master (Reflections III); 'Qui-Gon's Saber(R3)' dested Qui-Gon's Lightsaber (Reflections III); 'Anikan's Saber' dested Anakin's Lightsaber; 'Chewie's Saber/bowcaster' dested Chewbacca's Bowcaster (strategy: 'chewie's caster can target vehicles').
Posted 'Jar Jar' dested Jar Jar Binks; 'Naked Threepio' dested Threepio With His Parts Showing; 'Weapon Lev' dested the Light Weapon Levitation interrupt.
Posted 'Prep D' (Prepared Defenses is a Dark card) dested the Light starting interrupt Heading For The Medical Frigate, as in 21212 and 20525.
